summary: On an iPhone, tapping the Document reader's paste box zoomed the whole page in and left it zoomed, because the box's text was 13 px and Safari zooms on any box under 16 px. The box is now 16 px, like every other form box in the app, so tapping it to paste a statement keeps the page as it was.
points: The Document reader's paste box is 16 px; it was the last form box in the app under 16 px.
An iPhone no longer zooms the page when you tap it, so you do not have to pinch back out after pasting.
Checked every other box in the app: all are 16 px or more.
